title: Flow Canvas window forgets its position across app restarts (size is remembered, location isn't)
existing_state: FlowCanvasForm caches its location only in a static session field (UI/FlowCanvasForm.cs:31-32, 46-50, 77-81); SavePersistedSize persists width/height alone, and only from Dispose (518-534). Models/AppConfiguration.cs:499-500 has FlowCanvasWidth/Height but no Left/Top. So a user who parks the canvas on a second monitor gets it re-centered on the parent every app launch. The newer RunOutputWindowForm already does this right: it persists both size and location from FormClosing using last-Normal-state values (UI/RunOutputWindowForm.cs:45-47, 73, 215-240). Neither form clamps the restored position to current monitor bounds.
recommendation: Mirror RunOutputWindowForm in FlowCanvasForm: add WindowState.FlowCanvasLeft/Top, restore them in the ctor (session cache > persisted > CenterParent), and save geometry in FormClosing instead of Dispose. While there, add a Screen.AllScreens bounds clamp to both forms' restore paths so a saved position on a disconnected monitor snaps back on-screen.
user_benefit: Daily users with a two-monitor setup (the explicit target of the detachable Run Output work) stop re-dragging the canvas to its spot every session — table-stakes behavior for professional tools.

evidence.note: Session-only location; size-only persistence written in Dispose
Reference implementation: size+location persisted from FormClosing
